Regional authorities are using and downloading they data in Latvian Open Data portal.
+
I would like to clarify that there are no regional and national portals in Latvia. According to the legislation of the Republic of Latvia, there is one portal, which is the Latvian Open Data Portal, where data is published by both state institutions and local government institutions, which are regional institutions. 
As to whether regional authorities use the data available on the portal, the answer is yes, as do public authorities.
